features.mentorText: Conversation with the student at every project step: questions, hints, references to university regulations.
features.evaluationText: Rubric-based scoring with reasoning and recommendations; the answer strictly follows a schema.
features.generationText: Pitch decks, one-pagers, texts of grant and competition applications.
features.summaryText: Summaries of discussions and changes for supervisors and managers.
features.embeddingText: Vectors for searching the knowledge base. Changing the model triggers re-indexing.

notice.externalTitle: Data goes to an external AI provider
notice.externalText: Texts for AI are sent to a provider outside the university. IINs, phone numbers and email addresses are replaced with placeholders before sending and restored in the answer.
notice.limit: {{used}} of {{limit}} tokens used today. The limit renews at {{time}}.

settings.title: AI settings
settings.subtitle: Which models serve each feature, whether data may leave the university, and how much AI is available per day.
settings.staleText: Load the current version and make your changes again — otherwise you might overwrite theirs.

routes.title: Models by feature
routes.subtitle: A chain of providers: if the first is unavailable or declines, the request goes to the next one. Without a chain of its own, the server setting applies.
routes.noneUsable: No model is left for this feature: with “Local models only”, external providers are switched off. Add a local model or the feature will be unavailable.

policy.title: Usage policy
policy.subtitle: The rules apply to every AI feature of the university.
policy.localOnlyHint: Data never leaves the university infrastructure: external providers are removed from every chain.

modes.coachText: Asks questions and gives hints but does not write for the student. Recommended for study projects.
modes.coauthorText: May propose a ready wording for the student to edit. Suits preparing applications.

policy.tokensHint: {{value}} tokens a day, 0 means no limit. Renews at midnight.

usage.title: AI usage
usage.subtitle: Requests, tokens and cost by feature, model and day. Cost follows the provider's price list; local models are free.
usage.empty: AI has not been used yet
usage.emptyText: Statistics appear here once students work with the AI mentor or an administrator checks the connection.
usage.costHint: in US dollars, estimated from the price list

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.subtitle: University regulations, rules and guides. The AI mentor answers from them and cites the source.
knowledge.emptyText: Add competition regulations, grant rules or a guide — the AI mentor will rely on them and cite the source.
knowledge.indexFailed: The document could not be indexed. Try uploading it again.
knowledge.removeText: The AI mentor will stop relying on this document. This cannot be undone.
knowledge.addText: Paste text or upload a file. We split the document into passages and index it — usually within a few seconds.

search.title: Test the search
search.subtitle: Ask the way a student would — you will see the passages the AI mentor receives.
search.label: Question to the knowledge base
search.placeholder: For example: what is the application deadline?
search.empty: Nothing found. Try wording it differently.

form.title: Title
form.textPlaceholder: Paste the text. Section headings help the mentor cite the source precisely.
form.drop: Drop a file here or click to choose
form.fileRules: PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD up to 20 MB. Scans without a text layer are not supported.
form.wrongType: A PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD file is required.
form.tooLarge: The file is larger than 20 MB.
form.textTooLong: The text is too long: 4 MB at most. Upload it as a file or split it.
